Taxes, if any, must be quoted separately o therwise, it will be assumed that the rates are inclusive of all taxes, etc. The list of preferred makes/brands and material is attached in Annexure-II. 2. Due care shall be taken for not to include Financial bid in the Technical bid. Financial bid and Technical Bid are two separate documents. 3. Director, NIHSAD, Bhopal has every right to extend the date of submitting the bid. 4. The awarded work shall be completed with-in 60 days of issuing of purchase/w ork order otherwise Liquidated Damages shall be applicable at the rate of 0.5% per week of delay, subject to a maximum of 10% of the total contract value. 5. The bidder/contractor agrees to discharge the entire legal as well as other obli gations in respect of its employees in respect of their wages and other service c onditions and shall also comply with all the rules and regulations and provision of law in force that may be applicable to them from time to time. Statutory obligations under contract labour (Regulation and Abolition Act), 1970, Workme n's Compensation Act. EPF and MP Act, Industrial Dispute Act etc. The bidder/co ntractor agrees to indemnify and keep indemnified the Institute from any claims , loss or damages that may be caused to the institute on account of the bidder’s /contractor’s failure to comply with their obligations under the various laws tow ards its staff/employees for any loss or damage to the institute due to acts/omis sions of the contractor. 6. Loss and/or damages: In case of any loss or damage done to the property of th e Institute by the personnel provided by the Contractor, the full damages will be recovered from the contractor. 7. Warranty of atleast 01 Year shall be provided, which shall be effective from the date of satisfactory completion of work. 8. The payment shall be made within reasonable time say 30 days after completi on of work. No part payment will be made to the contractor. Since the mode of p ayment will be e-payment system, hence bank account number and name of th e bank with location and IFSC code of bank may be mentioned positively.

9. TDS will be deducted as per Govt. of India (GOI) rules. 10. Bidders have to sign a Bid securing declaration statement as per the following: - I/We hereby accept that, I/We will not withdraw or modify Bid furnish ed during period of validity (180 days), for the above mentioned work. 11. The successful bidder shall submit 5% performance security of the value of contract/order for a period of Fourteen (14) months in the form of FDR/accou nt payee DD in favour of ICAR Unit NIHSAD, Bhopal from a commercial bank within 8 (Eight) days of issue of notification of award (i.e. work/purchase order). 12. Payment of bill shall be made only after successful completion of the work and satisfactory work completion report. In case of short supply of work component, in terms of materials or measurement, deduction in the bill shall be made as pe r the rates quoted by the bidder. 13. Any modification, alteration, increase, decrease, or omission of any part of the scope of work/specifications at the time of issuance of the Work Order/Purchase Order shall be subject to the prior approval of the Director, ICAR-NIHSAD. Any s uch modification shall be carried out at the rates quoted by the firm. 14. If any deviation in interpretation of rules/provisions arises, the decision of the D irector, NIHSAD is final and shall be binding to the bidder. 15. Director, NIHSAD reserves every right to accept or reject the tender without an y reasons thereof. 16. All disputes shall be subject to Bhopal jurisdiction only. 17. All communications must be addressed to the Director /undersigned by Design ation only and not by name. 18. All the materials, tools and labours required for completion of work will be arra nged by the bidder. 19. Institute shall not be responsible for unloading, handling, storing or stocking of the material at site. 20. The bidder shall produce a self declaration for non-black listing/suspe nsion for the agency in any Govt. Organisation/Institute. 21. Before submitting their bid proposal, bidders are Strictly advised to visit the site and familiarize themselves with the site conditions and protocols of execution of work in Animal Bio Safety Level Labs and al so regarding work to be executed, equipment & materials to be requ ired, working space available, precautions required to taken during e xecution of work, etc. . 8.
